metadata.title: Zero Results and Data Quality Handling

story.iWant: to receive helpful guidance when my search returns no results and understand data limitations
story.soThat: I can adjust my filters effectively and interpret results correctly

tasks.task: Implement handle_zero_results(state) function with message and suggestions
Integrate zero results check at start of display_results()
Implement data_quality_warning() with PATSTAT limitations content
Make warning collapsible with Accordion widget, collapsed by default
Style warning as non-intrusive (muted colors, info style)
Add data quality warning to display_results() after export buttons
Validation: test with zero-result query, verify suggestions

acceptanceCriteria.ac: Zero results detected when all DataFrames empty, export buttons hidden
Clear message: "No patents found for this selection" with filter summary
Narrow date range (3 years or less) suggests: "Try expanding the date range"
SME filter enabled suggests: "Try disabling the SME filter"
Custom IPC mode suggests: "Try using a WIPO Technology Field instead"
Data quality warning appears below export buttons when results exist
Warning explains: applicant name variations, regional coverage, classification gaps
Warning collapsed by default with "Data Quality Notes" header
Warning visually subtle, does not obstruct charts
